授業科目の概要.科目名称: 共同資源工学研究企画
授業科目の概要.講義題目: Research Design in Cooperative Program for Resources Engineering
授業科目の概要.使用言語: 英語及び日本語を併用（E/J）
授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 通年集中 その他 その他
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
Overall Educational Objective:
To summarize and present the results of research related to Research Design in Cooperative Program for Resources Engineering in a lecture abstract.
Individual educational goal:
To acquire the ability to select a theme from a wide range of topics related to the field of Research Design in Cooperative Program for Resources Engineering, summarize the results of research, and present and discuss the results.
Lecture Plan:
1 Selection of research theme
2 Conducting research
3 Summarizing research results
4 Presentation at various academic societies and research meetings
How to proceed with the class:
Students will conduct research under the guidance of their laboratory supervisors, summarize the results of their research, and present their findings at various academic conferences and research meetings.
Examinations/grading methods, etc:
Credit will be given to students who make presentations at various academic societies and research groups including those outside the university, as determined by the supervising professor.
